title: Mitigating Bias in Algorithmic Hiring: Evaluating Claims and Practices
reasoning: The paper extensively evaluates vendor claims and practices in algorithmic hiring against established legal standards (e.g., the 4/5 rule, Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964) and psychological principles (e.g., APA Principles for Personnel Selection Procedures). It focuses on mitigating bias and ensuring fairness, which are core ethical concerns in AI development and deployment. This is more than a brief section on ethical considerations; it forms the central analytical framework of the paper.
